MonoBehaviour OnCollisionEnter.description: OnCollisionEnter is called when this collider/rigidbody has begun touching another rigidbody/collider.

MonoBehaviour OnCollisionEnter2D.description: Sent when an incoming collider makes contact with this object's collider (2D physics only).

MonoBehaviour OnCollisionExit.description: OnCollisionExit is called when this collider/rigidbody has stopped touching another rigidbody/collider.

MonoBehaviour OnCollisionExit2D.description: Sent when a collider on another object stops touching this object's collider (2D physics only).

MonoBehaviour OnCollisionStay.description: OnCollisionStay is called once per frame for every collider/rigidbody that is touching rigidbody/collider.

MonoBehaviour OnCollisionStay2D.description: Sent each frame where a collider on another object is touching this object's collider (2D physics only).

MonoBehaviour OnControllerColliderHit.description: OnControllerColliderHit is called when the controller hits a collider while performing a Move.

MonoBehaviour OnJointBreak.description: Called when a joint attached to the same game object broke.

MonoBehaviour OnJointBreak2D.description: Called when a Joint2D attached to the same game object breaks.

MonoBehaviour OnTriggerEnter.description: OnTriggerEnter is called when the Collider other enters the trigger.

MonoBehaviour OnTriggerEnter2D.description: Sent when another object enters a trigger collider attached to this object (2D physics only).

MonoBehaviour OnTriggerExit.description: OnTriggerExit is called when the Collider other has stopped touching the trigger.

MonoBehaviour OnTriggerExit2D.description: Sent when another object leaves a trigger collider attached to this object (2D physics only).

MonoBehaviour OnTriggerStay.description: OnTriggerStay is called once per frame for every Collider other that is touching the trigger.

MonoBehaviour OnTriggerStay2D.description: Sent each frame where another object is within a trigger collider attached to this object (2D physics only).
